newsitem.title: JAPAN: TENNIS-CROATIA'S MAJOLI SET TO FACE GRAF.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-CROATIA'S MAJOLI SET TO FACE GRAF.

text.p: Defending champion Iva Majoli of Croatia earned a clash with world number one Steffi Graf by beating Japan's top player, Ai Sugiyama, in the Pan Pacific women's open on Thursday.
The fifth seed ousted Sugiyama 7-5 7-5 to set the stage for a quarter-final on Friday against Graf, who easily defeated American Lisa Raymond on Wednesday.

Graf, who last week was knocked out of the Australian Open in the fourth round and then saw her father convicted of tax evasion, returned to tennis on Tuesday in an exhibition doubles match before playing Raymond..

In other matches, Amanda Coetzer of South Africa overlasted seventh-seeded Romanian Irina Spirlea 6-4 2-6 6-4 and will play Australian Open champion and second seed Martina Hingis of Switzerland on Friday.

Third-seeded Spaniard Conchita Martinez edged Kristie Boogert of the Netherlands 7-6 (7-5) 1-6 6-3 and will meet another Dutch player, eighth seed Brenda Schultz-McCarthy, who beat Japan's Naoko Sawamatsu 7-6 (7-4) 7-5.
Fourth seed Anke Huber of Germany got past American Kimberly Po 6-4 6-3, to set up a battle with American Lindsay Davenport, the conqueror of Tamarine Tanasugarn of Thailand 6-3 6-1 on Thursday.
